title: BiomeModes
description: A configurable Paper plugin that assigns different gameplay modes to different biomes.
body:
# BiomeModes v1.0.0 – Initial Release

BiomeModes is a configurable Paper plugin that assigns different gameplay modes to different biomes. As players move through the world, the plugin automatically detects the biome they are in and activates the gamemode assigned to that biome. This allows every biome to provide a unique survival experience without requiring separate worlds or servers.

For example, a server owner can configure:

* Desert → Lifesteal
* Taiga → Headsteal
* Deep Dark → Hardcore
* Mushroom Fields → Keep Inventory
* Ocean → Adventure

Every biome-to-gamemode mapping is fully configurable, allowing server owners to create their own gameplay combinations.

## Features

* Automatic biome-based gamemode switching
* Fully configurable biome-to-gamemode mappings
* Lifesteal, Headsteal, Hardcore, Keep Inventory, and Adventure modes
* BossBar displaying the current biome and active gamemode
* Offline and online player revival using player heads
* Anti-farming protection for Lifesteal
* Configurable sounds, messages, and gameplay settings
* Automatic data saving and persistent player progress

## Tested On

* Paper 1.21.4

## Feedback

This is the first public release of BiomeModes. Feedback, bug reports, and feature suggestions are greatly appreciated and will help improve future updates.
